title: 의문사가 없는 의문문 (Are you ~? / Do you ~?)
goal: be동사, 일반동사, 조동사 문장으로 Yes / No 질문을 만들고 짧게 대답할 수 있어요.

points.title: Yes / No로 대답하는 질문
points.body: who, what 같은 의문사 없이 '~예요? / ~해요?'라고 묻는 질문이에요. 대답은 Yes나 No로 시작해요.

points.title: be동사 문장은 be동사를 맨 앞으로
points.body: You are tired. → Are you tired? 과거도 같아요. It was fun. → Was it fun?

points.title: 일반동사 문장은 Do / Does / Did를 맨 앞에
points.body: Do(I / you / we / they), Does(he / she / it), Did(과거)를 앞에 놓고 동사는 동사원형으로 써요. Does she work here?

points.title: 조동사·현재완료는 그 단어를 앞으로
points.body: Can you ~? Will you ~? Should I ~?처럼 조동사를 앞으로 보내요. 현재완료는 Have you ~? / Has she ~? + p.p.예요.

points.title: 짧은 대답은 질문 단어 그대로
points.body: Are you ~? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Does he ~? → Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't. Can you ~? → Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

formula: Am / Is / Are / Was / Were + 주어 + ...?

mistakes.why: be동사 문장은 do를 쓰지 않고 be동사(Are)만 앞으로 보내요.
Does가 이미 -s를 맡았으니 뒤 동사는 동사원형이에요.

mistakes.wrong: Did you went to the party?
mistakes.right: Did you go to the party?
mistakes.why: Did가 과거를 맡으니까 뒤 동사는 과거형이 아니라 동사원형이에요.

examples.en: Are you on a working holiday visa?
Do you have a tax file number?
Does this tram go to the city?
Have you ever been to Uluru?
Will you be at home tonight?

quiz.why: from Korea는 be동사 문장, 주어 you → Are
일반동사 cook + 주어 your housemate(he / she) → Does

quiz.sentence: ___ she ever worked on a farm?
quiz.ko: 그녀는 농장에서 일해 본 적 있어요?
quiz.why: worked(p.p.) + ever → 현재완료, 주어 she → Has

quiz.sentence: A: Is the beach far from here? B: No, it ___.
quiz.ko: A: 해변이 여기서 멀어요? B: 아니요, 안 멀어요.
quiz.why: Is로 물었으니 대답도 be동사로 → No, it isn't.
be동사 문장, 주어 he → Is를 앞으로

quiz.answer: Does this bus go to Bondi Beach?
choices: Does this bus go to Bondi Beach?
Does this bus goes to Bondi Beach?
Is this bus go to Bondi Beach?
Do this bus go to Bondi Beach?

quiz.answer: Did you go to work yesterday?
choices: Did you go to work yesterday?
Did you went to work yesterday?
Do you went to work yesterday?
Were you go to work yesterday?

quiz.why: 일반동사 like + 주어 you → Do + 동사원형
hard는 상태라서 be동사 문장, 단수 과거 → Was

quiz.prompt: 'Do you have a car?'에 대한 맞는 대답을 고르세요.
quiz.why: Do로 물었으니 대답도 do로 → No, I don't.
